name: Multi-Trex Integrated Foods Plc
source: NGX doclib filing library: Multi-Trex Integrated Foods Plc unaudited statement of profit or loss for the year ended 30 April 2026, filed October 2026. Unit NGN, printed in thousands. Turnover NGN 3,609,441k less cost of sales NGN 3,096,743k reproduces the printed gross profit of NGN 512,698k exactly; other income NGN 73,212k, operating expenses NGN 1,114,992k and finance charges NGN 85,982k produce the printed loss before taxation of NGN 615,064k exactly, and tax is nil so the loss after taxation is also NGN 615,064k. Operating Profit (EBIT) is derived as the loss before taxation plus finance charges.
